item.title: Patreon - Space - Martian Basic Training
item.description: One of the most common questions I’m asked by kids and adults a-like is what I’d be learning if I’m selected as one of the 12-24 candidates who become full-time employees and start astronaut training leading up to 2031 - what are we actually going to be learning over the next 14 years My standard response in interviews is usually “everything”, before listing a bundle of different skill-sets that are both obvious (like repairing life support systems) and unexpected (like dentistry or politics).
